name: Mechanism Master
description: Successfully build and demonstrate three different advanced mechanisms (lift, intake, launcher)
criteria: Complete lessons on four-bar lifts, chain drives, and intake systems. Build and demonstrate all three mechanisms working effectively.

name: Gear Guru
description: Master compound gear systems and gear ratio calculations
criteria: Complete compound gearing lesson. Successfully calculate and build a gear train achieving 1:7 ratio. Demonstrate understanding through engineering notebook entry.

name: Autonomous Achiever
description: Create a fully autonomous routine that completes multiple tasks using sensors
criteria: Program an autonomous routine with at least 5 distinct actions using 2+ different sensors. Successfully run routine in competition or practice.

name: Strategy Specialist
description: Develop and document comprehensive match strategies
criteria: Create detailed match strategy document including autonomous plans, driver priorities, and alliance coordination. Use strategy successfully in 3+ matches.

name: Engineering Documenter
description: Maintain exemplary engineering notebook with detailed design documentation
criteria: Complete 10+ detailed engineering notebook entries including sketches, calculations, and reflection. Document full design process for one major mechanism.

name: Testing & Iteration Pro
description: Complete multiple design-test-improve cycles with measured results
criteria: Document 3+ complete iteration cycles on a single mechanism. Include measurements, test results, and specific improvements made each iteration.

name: Team Coordinator
description: Successfully coordinate team roles and responsibilities
criteria: Lead team organization including role assignments, meeting schedules, and task delegation. Complete 5+ practice sessions with documented team coordination.
